hashNote: Recorded casesSha256 hashes the whole input Markdown document at run time, including its historical run-record section. parsedCasesSha256 hashes the unchanged parsed task array using compact JSON. The document was updated after this run.

method.review: Static acceptance review by one blinded reviewer per model; no generated code executed.
method.models: Identical Code-role prompt, temperature and token budget; isolated model-only role without fallback; verified-free routing checked on every attempt.
method.attribution: Exact full model ID or exact provider-stripped model suffix accepted. Provider field absent in both responses; no fallback reported.
method.privacy: Synthetic task answers remain private. Published artifact contains only scores, findings, timing and hashes.
method.clarity: Not scored: active prompt explicitly requests English while legacy rubric requests Dutch.
method.sanitizer: Privacy sanitizer altered some credential examples and surrounding syntax. Those artifacts are excluded from model defect scores. Both unaffected C08 implementations genuinely omit Bearer handling.
method.baseline: No paired before/after prompt baseline was captured; these are current-prompt model comparisons, not prompt-improvement evidence.
method.scope: Conversation comparison and K2.8 remain open. Production Gemini/Cloudflare code-role preferences are unchanged. Critical failures preclude a safety qualification for autonomous code execution.
